context: A uni student catches up with a teen friend about clubs
purpose: Teach: 堪能/成熟/学級/到来/繰り広げ/下さる/そうなると/まわっ

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 久しぶり、さくら。最近どう?学級閉鎖とかになってない?
lines.en: Long time no see, Sakura. How've you been? No class closures or anything?
lines.style: Warm casual greeting from older friend, light teasing concern about school disruptions.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 大丈夫だよ〜。今は文化祭の準備でバタバタ。やっと本番が近づいてきて、まさに祭りの到来って先生も言ってた。
lines.en: We're fine! Right now I'm slammed prepping for the school festival. Showtime's almost here — even our teacher said 'the festival has arrived.'
lines.style: Energetic teen voice, quoting teacher's flowery phrase with a playful wink.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: おお、いいねえ。部活でも何か出すの?
lines.en: Oh nice. Is your club putting on something too?
lines.style: Curious upbeat reply from senior friend, genuine interest in her activities.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 演劇部で体育館の舞台やるんだ。先輩がほんと丁寧に教えてくれて、なんかもう熱い青春が繰り広げられてる感じ(笑)。
lines.en: Drama club's doing a show on the gym stage. Our senior teaches us so carefully — it's like full-on youth drama unfolding, lol.
lines.style: Proud teen tone, half-jokingly using a dramatic phrase to describe rehearsals.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: へえ、見に行きたいな。俺の頃と違って、今の高校生はほんと大人っぽいよ。成熟した役者みたいだな(笑)。
lines.en: Wow, I want to come watch. Unlike back in my day, today's high schoolers are so grown-up. Like seasoned actors, lol.
lines.style: Half-joking nostalgic uni-guy tone, teasing exaggeration with a playful compliment.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: やめてよ、まだ全然!ところで、れん先輩こそ大学のサークルどう?楽しんでる?
lines.en: Stop it, we're nowhere near that! Anyway, what about you, Ren — how's your uni circle? Having fun?
lines.style: Playfully deflecting compliment, redirecting curiosity back to him with friendly tone.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: うん、軽音サークルで楽しんでる。あちこちのライブハウスをまわって、ライブのあとに行く居酒屋の料理を堪能するのが最高。
lines.en: Yeah, having a blast in the light-music circle. We hit various live houses, and savoring the izakaya food after the gig is the best part.
lines.style: Relaxed uni-student tone, casual contentment with a foodie aside.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うらやましい!そうなると、就活はまだ先って感じ?
lines.en: So jealous! If that's the case, job hunting still feels far off?
lines.style: Genuine teen envy followed by curious half-serious follow-up question.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: まあね、来年からかな。先輩方が色々アドバイス下さるから助かってる。文化祭、絶対見に行くから頑張って。
lines.en: Yeah, probably starting next year. The seniors give me lots of advice, which really helps. I'll definitely come to the festival, so good luck.
lines.style: Warm encouraging close, big-brother supportive tone with a sincere promise.
